_说明: m07 儿歌试听专用（只有 song 段），正式 story.json 等漫画剧本确认后再写

styles: the traditional French nursery round Frere Jacques (Are You Sleeping Brother John), its exact original melody and rhythm, nothing else
a warm, smiling young female singer with a few happy kids singing along, natural expressive human voice, joyful
simple glockenspiel and pizzicato strings doubling the melody, 120 BPM, C major

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.direction: sing the exact Frere Jacques melody: C D E C, C D E C, E F G-, E F G-, G A G F E C, G A G F E C, C G, C-, C G, C-; happy running feeling
lines: Two little tigers, two little tigers,
Run so fast, run so fast!
One has got no ears, one has got no tail.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.direction: exact Frere Jacques melody: C D E C, C D E C, E F G-, E F G-, G A G F E C, C G, C-; start soft, then louder and louder, ding dang dong very loud and happy
lines: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping,

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.direction: exact Frere Jacques melody: G A G F E C, G A G F E C, C G, C-, C G, C-; big happy cheer, everyone together
lines: Now we've got our ears, now we've got our tail.
